recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-13192 unless FHIR-I later wants optional editorial polishing from '/metadata' to a linked 'metadata endpoint' phrase.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for STU3 asking to remove the deprecated HTTP OPTIONS reference from the capability-statement-kind value set's instance code definition and instead describe the kind as returned by the metadata endpoint.
initial_application: The change appears to have been applied before this reconciliation. Jira's only comment on 2017-12-18 says 'already fxied', and commit ec09ca8c8d7e1dc670d74f0270defce4f76da409c changed the active CapabilityStatement spreadsheet definition from 'returned by OPTIONS' to 'returned by /metadata' on the same date.
additional_context: The current ValueSet source composes all codes from http://hl7.org/fhir/capability-statement-kind, so the relevant definition lives in source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-capability-statement-kind.xml. source/fhir.ini actively lists CapabilityStatement as a build resource, and CapabilityStatement.kind binds to ValueSet/capability-statement-kind. The related HTTP OPTIONS removal issue FHIR-17322 is already represented on the combined branch and supports the same /metadata behavior.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current CodeSystem instance definition says the kind is returned by /metadata, the ValueSet includes that CodeSystem, and current source has no 'returned by OPTIONS' matches to remove.
